Sniper: Hold right-click (or Control-click on Mac) to scope. Release to fire, or left-click while scoped. Left-clicking prevents a second shot on release. Escape cancels the shot. The scope settles in 0.25 seconds. Headshots deal 100 damage for the first 0.65 seconds of each scope hold, then 95; body damage is 80, then 76. Hip-fire and movement reduce accuracy.

Air scope: Scoping with the sniper in the air stops movement for up to 0.6 seconds, once per jump or fall. Shots are accurate after the scope settles. You take 50% more damage while hovering. Releasing scope ends the hover; landing resets it.

Shotgun: Two shells. Pellet spread and damage falloff reduce effectiveness at range.

Knife: Left-click to stab. Right-click or Q to throw. Returns after 3 seconds.

Movement: Space to jump. Hold C to crouch; release to stand when there is room. Ladders cannot be climbed.

Modes: Practice is first to 5 rounds. At the time limit, higher health wins; equal health is a draw. Explore disables damage and the timer. Press T in Explore to reset your position.
